speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Have there been any changes to the websites you often visit?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Yes, there have been some changes. I used to watch Bilibili — the Chinese YouTube — but these days I watch YouTube more often, because I wanted to break through the information barrier. And also, I need to learn English, and almost everything on YouTube is in English. So I switched from Bilibili to YouTube to improve my English and get more information.
